# H&Q Design Services (HANDQ)
> Premier Architectural Design, 3D Elevation Modeling, Luxury Interiors, and Turnkey Construction Studio based in Lahore, Pakistan.

H&Q Design Services is a licensed architecture and engineering studio (PCATP and PEC affiliated) serving clients across Pakistan (DHA Lahore, Bahria Town, Islamabad, Karachi) and international expatriates (Saudi Arabia, UAE, UK, USA).

## Main Sections & Tools
- [Homepage](https://h-q-design-services.vercel.app/): Studio overview, featured 3D elevations, and client testimonials.
- [Architectural Services](https://h-q-design-services.vercel.app/services): 2D floor plans, 3D architectural rendering, structural vetting, and MEP engineering drawings.
- [Design Portfolio](https://h-q-design-services.vercel.app/portfolio): 500+ completed residential villas (5 Marla, 10 Marla, 1 Kanal) and commercial plaza elevations.
- [Construction Cost Calculator 2026](https://h-q-design-services.vercel.app/tools): Itemized grey structure and turnkey finishing cost estimation with current Pakistan material indices.
- [Area Guides & Bylaws](https://h-q-design-services.vercel.app/area-guides): Building bylaws, height restrictions, setback requirements for DHA Lahore, Bahria Town, and LDA.
- [Market Trends 2026](https://h-q-design-services.vercel.app/trends): Real estate price index, construction material rate forecasts, and ROI insights.
- [Google Client Reviews](https://h-q-design-services.vercel.app/reviews): Verified 5.0-star customer ratings and design case studies.
- [Architectural Guides & Blog](https://h-q-design-services.vercel.app/blog): Technical articles on soil testing, concrete mix designs, false ceilings, and interior styling.
- [Contact Studio](https://h-q-design-services.vercel.app/contact): Booking consultations, phone lines (+92 341 6887454), and international WhatsApp desk (+966 50 714 3124).
